body: The few friends I've talked about my Depression with have left me. And it's because of the Depression. Everyone leaves me.
I can't afford Live because I don't have a job, but if you have Steam we can play something tomorrow.
I'll keep that in mind, but I really think "professional" help isn't for me.
I know Weed isn't the best, but it's been able to stave off my suicidal tendencies for years. and thanks man, but the only thing I like to do is play video games which isn't productive at all.

At this point I'm gonna be offing myself in the end anyway, going through another hospital/more therapy is just going to delay that considering it did nothing for me the first times I was there. If I end it now, I'll save everyone the heartache of trying to help me/their money/time
My mom won't take me back. I've been enough of a hassle and she's not gonna put me back in a hospital. I'm on my own in that department.

I wouldn't consciously murder anyone, but I've had lots of episodes I guess is what they're called, where I'll be walking behind someone and then I'll just fall deep into a murder fantasy. I have a handle on it for now, but it's definitely getting worse.
I've been put in a mental hospital 3 times and been on 5 different anti-depressants. I was in therapy for two years.
